finding.title: Failed February normalized-data fingerprint uses transport order
finding.cause: The incident fingerprinted normalized records in provider transport order instead of canonical OHLCV records sorted by symbol and timestamp, which is the stored Program 002 segment representation.
finding.impact: A later reviewer cannot use the recorded field as exact normalized-evidence integrity proof. The row counts, seven missing coordinates, consecutive-gap classification, quarantine identity, and control stop remain unchanged.
finding.required_remediation: Preserve incident v2 as rejected history and create a corrected immutable v3 incident that binds this review failure and the canonical sorted normalized fingerprint.

proof_gaps: Artifact inspection supports the stated absence of exposed datasets, quotes, costs, Campaign 1 binding, and execution outputs but cannot independently prove every historical non-access claim.
The reviewer did not inspect credential values or query provider or account endpoints.
scope_limit: No credential value, provider or account endpoint, new market or quote data, strategy result, controlled or protected data, PAPER or broker state, live state, or strategic-allocation-21 state was accessed during this review.
required_next_step: Publish and independently review a corrected v3 incident binding before accepting the February stop record or reviewing authority-v6 revocation.
